reason: Batch 003 source audit removed unsupported parking-structure geometry locators. PD 1096 Rule VII supports slot/loading sizes and plan indication; BP 344 supports accessible parking details. Rule XIX, Section 803, and Section 904 are not parking geometry locators.

proposed.text: A reviewer asks whether a vehicle ramp gradient can be cited to PD 1096 Rule XIX or Section 904 in this cited sources. What is the correct source-backed answer?

options.text: Yes, Rule XIX is the off-street parking rule
Yes, Section 904 gives drive-aisle and ramp-gradient values
No. The checked PD 1096 source did not verify vehicle ramp gradient under Rule XIX or Section 904; use a verified parking-design source or project standard before teaching that value
No, because ramp gradients are never design-relevant

proposed.rationale: Rule XIX is The Use of Computers and Section 904 is Storm Drainage System in the checked PD 1096 IRR.
proposed.explanation: The old 1:8/1:6 ramp-gradient question used the wrong local-source locator.
